segments.title: April
segments.text: Hello Kemps Corner! April is our birthday month. Nine years of Physique 57, and the theme is Cloud Nine. The confetti budget has been approved. So has the target.

segments.title: ₹60L
segments.text: So, the number. Our April target for Kemps Corner is 60 lakh rupees. That's 20 per cent up on last April. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 33 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 14.4 lakh, comebacks 7.2 lakh, and everything else 5.4 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 129 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 941 leads, 480 trials, and 129 buyers, with about 27 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.
Here's where the offers come in. Six offers carry 45.1 lakh rupees, which is 75 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Cloud Nine Limited Edition
segments.text: First up, the headliner, Cloud Nine Limited Edition. Nine months, nine freezes, plus one month on us. That's 11 buyers, for 18.1 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members on 1 Month or class packs.

segments.title: Plus One, Plus Nine
segments.text: Next, Plus One, Plus Nine. Bring a friend who joins and get nine bonus days. That's 11 buyers, for 1.89 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Party Crasher Pass
segments.text: Then, for newcomers, the Party Crasher Pass. Three classes, including the birthday party class, at a tiny price that comes off their first month if they join. That's 21 buyers, for 3.4 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Where Are They Now?
segments.text: Also this month, for old friends, Where Are They Now? Fifteen per cent off to come back, a bonus class for every year they've known us, and a seat at the Throwback Reunion. That's 23 buyers, for 3.96 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Standard lapsed 15% + max 3 bonus classes (≤20% effective on a 12-class pack)

segments.title: Spin Class (Literally)
segments.text: After that, Spin Class, literally. Renew in April for ten per cent off, then spin the Wheel of Nine. That's 49 buyers, for 8.93 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Club Nine: The Founders' Table
segments.text: And finally, Club Nine, The Founders' Table. Nine numbered annual seats per studio, with double the perks, a numbered jacket, and a name on the wall. That's 5 buyers, for 8.78 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, the numbered memberships go live, with a public counter. Week two, the party class brings new faces in, and every guest gets a follow-up. Week three, the wheel spins and the Club Nine seats close. Week four, the Throwback Reunion brings old friends home.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's April at Kemps Corner. 60 lakh rupees, six offers, and 129 buyers to welcome. Nine years in, and honestly? We've never looked better.
